notes.content:
Dear friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/ceb81842a390c9cbcc54923be83f30840fea2937.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368277/628cc83c5a0fcfb2165ccae60fb2c7e5862b4ff6.jpg

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/ee1a659bf0917d6c00ca79d4fb830245097bd5c6.jpg
Hey, friends!

We are happy to announce that we already fixed more than 15 reported bugs and issues since the release! And we also added the much-requested ability to skip the text from the very beginning of the game. If you would like to help us with the further development, we would appreciate more honest and thorough reviews.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Release tomorrow!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/18cb6e04193ae41a30b166f6d5b656918a6cdf84.jpg
Dear comrades, it is with great pleasure we announce that the release of the Sex with Stalin happens tomorrow, 10 AM PST. 

P.S.

Our enemies tried to sabotage the development and prevent the game from ever seeing the light of day, but they failed! Let your friends know, add the game to the wishlist, and wait for the announcement!
